T: They're creepy, they're kooky, they're eating.
D: The Addams family's long-lost Uncle Fester turns up, or does he.
P: Serve the lemonade when Wednesday sets up her lemonade stand.
S: Shortcrust dough rolled into finger shapes, a flaked almond nail pressed in each, knuckles scored, baked at 180C for 12 minutes.
she cuts off the blooms and keeps the stems
Beetroot crisps sliced paper thin on a mandoline, tossed in oil, baked at 150C for 25 minutes until curled like petals, salted.
the Mamushka dance at Fester's homecoming

Dark rye toasts topped with pickled herring, sour cream and dill, and roast beetroot with horseradish cream, a Russian-style plate for the family dance. Wrap 3 beetroot in foil and roast at 200C for 50 minutes, then peel and dice. Toast 8 slices dark rye and cut in half. Mix 100g sour cream with chopped dill. Mix 100g crème fraîche with 1 tbsp horseradish. Top half the toasts with dill cream and 200g pickled herring pieces and red onion. Top the rest with horseradish cream and beetroot. Finish with dill and pepper.
M: dinner at the long dining table
Beef rib roast seasoned overnight, roasted at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C, rested 20 minutes, carved at the table with roast potatoes and horseradish.
Grandmama stirring something in the kitchen

Beef shin braised black-dark in red wine with onion, carrot, garlic and mushrooms until it falls apart, ladled over buttery mash from a big black pot. Toss 1.2kg diced beef shin with 2 tbsp flour and brown in batches. Cook 2 onions, 2 carrots and 3 garlic cloves for 8 minutes. Add 2 tbsp tomato paste, 375ml red wine, 500ml beef stock, thyme and bay. Return the beef, cover and cook at 160C for 3 hours, adding 250g mushrooms for the last 30 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 80g butter and 150ml milk. Serve from the pot.
W: Chocolate sponge layers soaked in kirsch syrup, filled with whipped cream and morello cherries, covered in shaved dark chocolate.
K: the lemonade stand, made from real lemons

Fresh lemon juice blended with blackberries and sugar syrup into a deep inky purple lemonade, served over ice with a sprig of mint. Blend 250g blackberries (frozen is fine) with 150ml sugar syrup and the juice of 5 lemons, then strain through a sieve, pressing hard. Pour into a jug with 1L cold water and stir. Chill for 30 minutes. Serve over ice in 4 tall glasses with a few whole blackberries, a lemon slice and a mint sprig.

s.how: Rub 100g butter into 200g flour, then add 1 egg to a dough. Roll into 16 finger shapes, press a flaked almond in the tip of each and score knuckles with a knife. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes.

s.note: she cuts off the blooms and keeps the stems
s.how: Slice 3 beetroots paper thin on a mandoline. Toss with 2 tbsp olive oil and spread on lined trays. Bake at 150C for 25 minutes until curled and crisp, then sprinkle with flaky salt.

m.note: dinner at the long dining table
m.how: Season a 2kg beef rib roast with salt, garlic and rosemary overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 160C until 52C inside. Rest 20 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Carve at the candlelit table with horseradish.

w.how: Whisk 4 eggs with 150g sugar until thick, then fold in 120g self-raising flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 175C for 25 minutes and split. Brush with syrup and 3 tbsp kirsch. Layer with 400ml whipped cream and morello cherries. Shave dark chocolate on top.

d.note: the lemonade stand, made from real lemons

Chill for 30 minutes. Serve over ice in 4 tall glasses with a few whole blackberries, a lemon slice and a mint sprig.
